messages:
maya.l: Auditor requested a compact evidence package for controls mapping: RBAC changes since 2025-01-01, deploy session proofs for privileged promotions, and KMS envelope metadata tied to secrets used in the rollout. Deadline Wednesday.

devon.k: Scope confirmed: production clusters + CI service accounts only. Will produce RBAC diffs and PR links.

samira: For the deploy proofs, do they want a parsed CSV timeline + raw log snippets?

auditor_amy: Parsed timeline preferred, include 3 raw samples for provenance. Need approver -> CI job -> session_id chainable entries. Redact emails per PII rules.

ops_jordan: We can export bastion and CI audit events. Sample lines we'll include:

2025-02-18T09:12:34Z deploy-job=ci-deploy-frontend run=6789 user=devon.k session_id=sess-abc123 action=promote_to_prod
2025-02-18T09:12:40Z session=sess-abc123 exec=kubectl apply -f release/2025-02-18

maya.l: For KMS metadata include kms_key_id, key_version, rotation_timestamp, and envelope_fingerprint. Also a short statement that plaintext secret material is never persisted.

devon.k: secrets-operator DB has envelope_fingerprint and kms_key_id on encrypt. I'll export rows bounded to secrets touched by those CI runs and include KMS rotation events.

samira: Auditor also asked for the Feb CVE patch PR and the risk acceptance memo for historical lib issue.

maya.l: Include IR crosswalk mapping control IDs -> runbooks -> escalation owners. Auditor wants a 2-line fallback description if KMS is unavailable during deploy.

ops_jordan: Playbook excerpt: deploys fail-closed if KMS unreachable. We validate cached envelope metadata for audit-only reads; emergency key escrow allowed only by SRE lead with recorded approval.

audit-bot: export initiated: session-log-export-179111-01 (ETA 3m)

auditor_amy: Good. Please also add a one-column CSV mapping each RBAC change -> PR title -> owner -> justification for quick review.

devon.k: Will redact emails and add the CSV.

maya.l: Plan: devon & samira create artifacts today, ops_jordan attach session samples and playbook excerpt, I will assemble and run QA. Target upload to secure share by 2025-02-19 16:00 PT.

samira: ack, will attach CVE PR link.

ops_jordan: ack, will upload exports when done.

auditor_amy: Thanks everyone. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
